latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.1.0 of guomeiqing-safe-install

- Introduces a thorough 7-step security audit before installing any third-party OpenClaw Skill.
- Downloads requested skills into a temporary, isolated directory instead of the live skills folder.
- Audits for outbound data transmissions, credential access, dangerous shell commands, disguised behaviors, unwarranted privilege escalation, prompt injection, and script file security.
- Generates a human-readable security review report summarizing findings with PASS/WARN/DANGER indicators for each tested area.
- Only completes installation if the skill passes all audit checks; otherwise, it warns or blocks as appropriate.
- Provides clear triggers and user guidance for safe skill installation workflows.
